verdict.rationale: BAMF is the German Federal Office for Migration and Refugees, a government agency whose website offers information and advice on migration, asylum and integration. It is not a software tool that could be run headlessly or in CI, so this axis is a category error. Nothing in the evidence shows any automation or CLI capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
